neighbours.label: quantifier or article right after a sentence-initial preposition ('In many ways', 'In some instances', 'En los')
fire: In many ways the island is a paradox.
In some instances there has been a mixture.
In most cases the patients recover quickly.
In several respects the plan is flawed.
In these moments, doubt takes over.
In many countries the law is different.
In some places the road is closed.
In all cases the rule applies.
quiet: The law in France is different.
The road near the river is closed.
